space.$description: Spacing scale on a 4px grid; keys are the pixel value.

control.$description: Interactive control heights. Recipes consume these through the density.* semantic aliases (never directly), so the user density axis can shift the whole ladder; xs exists as the compact floor for sm controls (still a workable pointer target beside 15-16px text).

focus-ring.$description: Focus-ring outline geometry — mode-invariant lengths consumed directly by recipes (the focus-ring COLOR is the semantic focus.ring token). Tokenized so components.css carries no literal lengths (design-system area CLAUDE.md: focus-ring width/offset must become tokens before the Tier 1 Button lands).

border-width.$description: Border widths — mode-invariant lengths consumed directly by recipes (the border COLOR is the semantic border.* token). Design language §6: structure is 1px hairline rules and surface tints, shadow reserved for floating layers. Tokenized so components.css carries no literal lengths, exactly as focus-ring width/offset were before the Tier 1 control recipes (Input, Card, Separator, ...) landed.

size.$description: Named layout dimensions for app-shell chrome — mode-invariant, consumed directly by recipes (like control/focus-ring/border-width). The global sidebar (page-archetypes Layout A) is a fixed-width rail that collapses to an icon rail; its two widths are tokens so the mc-sidebar recipe carries no literal length.
